capabilities: Split notes by headings, dates or dividers
Merge related notes and concatenate files into one document
Categorize notes with tags or backlinks and move or copy them
Rewrite, rate or generalize notes with an AI provider
disambiguation: Not a writing-consistency checker; it runs bulk file operations and optional AI rewrites on notes.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+), no mobile support. No plugin-wide undo or automatic backup; the README advises backing up the vault and testing on copied notes, and a failed batch can leave some operations completed. API keys are masked in settings but stored in the local data.json. No telemetry, accounts or paid features; donations optional.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to run the same summarize, split, merge, rename or deduplicate operation across many notes at once.

relations.evidence: Ollama: run Ollama with a downloaded model.
Unsloth · OpenAI compatible: start Unsloth, enter its API base URL
OpenAI compatible: enter a server’s API base URL including its prefix (usually /v1)

requires.name: API key for the OpenAI-compatible server

summary: Bulk note toolkit that summarizes, splits, merges, categorizes and rewrites notes, with optional AI through Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers.
